name: What is the difference between a natural rock waterfall and a sheer descent waterfall?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a natural rock waterfall and a sheer descent waterfall?

acceptedAnswer.text: A natural rock waterfall features a more organic, irregular flow, often constructed with stacked boulders and stones to mimic a natural stream or cascade. These typically have a softer, more diffused sound. In contrast, a sheer descent waterfall creates a smooth, unbroken sheet of water that flows from a slim, linear opening, often integrated into a wall or raised beam. This style offers a more contemporary, precise aesthetic and a distinct, consistent water sound. Your choice depends on your desired aesthetic and sound preference.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural rock waterfalls are organic with diffused sound, while sheer descent waterfalls offer a contemporary, smooth sheet of water from a linear opening.
